biotools.summary: VASCilia is an open-source Napari plugin suite that uses deep learning to segment, orient, and quantify 3D confocal microscopy images of cochlear hair cell stereocilia bundles, providing automated measurements, tonotopic position prediction, and hair cell subtype classification for auditory research.
